sources.excerpt: 1987 Japanese novel narrated in first person by Toru Watanabe, aged 37, looking back on his college years in late-1960s Tokyo amid student strikes; relationships with Naoko, who lives in a mountain sanatorium, and Midori, whose father has brain cancer. A story of loss. 2010 film.
